task.title: Receipt OCR to structured JSON
task.business_story: Expense-management and bookkeeping tools turn photographed receipts into ledger entries; after OCR the text is jumbled, and a model has to pull out the line items and totals for every receipt a customer uploads. It runs once per document at high volume, so the per-call price decides the margin.

verdict.system_prompt:
Extract receipt data as JSON only. Rules:
1. ITEMS: Lines with a printed line total (integer with optional dots/commas). Name = text before that number. Quantity = leading integer if present, else null. Price = line total as integer (remove separators). Ignore sub-items/modifiers (lines without line total, or indented, or price 0).
2. TOTALS: Match labels case-insensitively.
   - Subtotal: label contains SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL/NET SALES/NET AMT.
   - Discount: label contains DISC/PROMO/LESS/OFF.
   - Service Charge: label contains SVC/SERVICE/CHG.
   - Tax: label contains TAX/PAJAK/PB1/PPN.
   - Total: label TOTAL/GRAND TOTAL/TOTAL DUE (not Subtotal).
   - Cash Paid: label CASH/BAYAR/PAY.
   - Change: label CHANGE/CHANGED/KEMBALI.
3. Values: integers only (strip Rp, dots, commas). Null if missing.
4. Discounts are positive numbers.
5. Do not infer missing fields from math.

import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B'
THINKING = False  # Nemotron reasoning; off is faster and cheaper
SYSTEM = 'Extract receipt data as JSON only. Rules:\n1. ITEMS: Lines with a printed line total (integer with optional dots/commas). Name = text before that number. Quantity = leading integer if present, else null. Price = line total as integer (remove separators). Ignore sub-items/modifiers (lines without line total, or indented, or price 0).\n2. TOTALS: Match labels case-insensitively.\n   - Subtotal: label contains SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL/NET SALES/NET AMT.\n   - Discount: label contains DISC/PROMO/LESS/OFF.\n   - Service Charge: label contains SVC/SERVICE/CHG.\n   - Tax: label contains TAX/PAJAK/PB1/PPN.\n   - Total: label TOTAL/GRAND TOTAL/TOTAL DUE (not Subtotal).\n   - Cash Paid: label CASH/BAYAR/PAY.\n   - Change: label CHANGE/CHANGED/KEMBALI.\n3. Values: integers only (strip Rp, dots, commas). Null if missing.\n4. Discounts are positive numbers.\n5. Do not infer missing fields from math.'
FEW_SHOT = [{'content': '1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636\n'
             'SubTotal: 13,636\n'
             'PB1: 1,364\n'
             'Total: 15,000\n'
             'cash: 20,000\n'
             'Change: 5,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "Peanut & Cheese", "quantity": 1, "price": 13636}], "subtotal": '
             '13636, "discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 1364, "total": 15000, '
             '"cash_paid": 20000, "change": 5000}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 20,000\nTT 20,000\nTOTAL 20,000\nCASH 100,000\nCHANGE 80,000', 'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "TT", "quantity": 1, "price": 20000}], "subtotal": null, '
             '"discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": null, "total": 20000, "cash_paid": '
             '100000, "change": 80000}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 BLACK PEPPER MEATBALL 76,500\n'
             '1 QUARTO FORMANGGI PASTA 82,500\n'
             '1 GREEN TEA WITH CRUMBLE 56,000\n'
             '2 ORIGINAL BREWED TEA 46,000\n'
             'SUBTTL 261,000\n'
             'SVC CHG 6% 15,660\n'
             'PB1 10% 27,666\n'
             'TOTAL 304,326',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "BLACK PEPPER MEATBALL", "quantity": 1, "price": 76500}, '
             '{"name": "QUARTO FORMANGGI PASTA", "quantity": 1, "price": 82500}, {"name": "GREEN '
             'TEA WITH CRUMBLE", "quantity": 1, "price": 56000}, {"name": "ORIGINAL BREWED TEA", '
             '"quantity": 2, "price": 46000}], "subtotal": 261000, "discount": null, '
             '"service_charge": 15660, "tax": 27666, "total": 304326, "cash_paid": null, "change": '
             'null}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 PAKET BER2 69,091\n'
             '1 BREAD N CHEESE DEL\n'
             '1 MAC N CHEESE DEL\n'
             '1 PEPSI DEL\n'
             '1 P/P THUOSAND ISL DEL\n'
             '1 LIPTON ICE TEA DEL\n'
             'SUBTOTAL 69,091\n'
             'TAX 6,909\n'
             'TOTAL 76,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "PAKET BER2", "quantity": 1, "price": 69091}], "subtotal": '
             '69091, "discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 6909, "total": 76000, '
             '"cash_paid": null, "change": null}',
  'role': 'assistant'}]


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=445,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
